title.narrative: Public Financial Management Accountability in the Democratic Republic of Congo

description.narrative:
"The proposed project development objective is to enhance the credibility, transparency, and accountability in the management and use of central government and selected sub-national governmentsâ€™ finances. Considering the complementarity with other donor-funded programs, the proposed MDTF operation will focus on downstream PFM reforms of the central government and public financial management in selected provinces. The Program will contribute to :
(i) improve budget credibility and transparency through enhancement of public access to key financial information and demand side for governance; (ii) improve controls over public spending through strengthening internal controls, external audit and legislative oversight; and (iii) build and strengthen public sector and financial management systems in selected provinces (Equator; Kasai-Oriental and North Kivu).
In addition, the objectives of the Bank-executed component is to assist the Bank in (i) coordinating donors support for public financial management reform in DRC and (ii)leading dialogue with the Government of DRC to agree on a single reform program for public financial management reform (including decentralization reform), as fully financed and supported by donors through a MDTF. It will also serve to administer the MDTF, provide enhanced supervision of the project, and conduct analytical works."
